description: Demonstrates the MCP Tasks API with a countdown timer. When the client supports tasks, returns immediately with a task handle for polling. Otherwise, runs synchronously and returns the result directly.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for the async countdown task.

message.description: Optional message to include in the final result

seconds.description: Number of seconds to count down (1-60)

simulateFailure.description: If true, simulates a failure at 50% progress (for testing)

name: template_async_countdown

outputSchema.description: Result of the completed async countdown task.

title: Async Countdown (Task Demo)
